headline: 37 protocol contracts across 7 chains: 7 LP Locker V2, 5 LP Locker V3, 8 Token Vesting V2, 8 Locker V1, plus legacy addresses

findings.text: Block-explorer name-tag searches deferred due to domain access restrictions; addresses sourced from official GitHub repositories with authoritative deployment records.

Official deployments documented in GitHub repo READMEs: liquidity-locker-univ2-contracts, liquidity-locker-univ3-contracts, and token-vesting-contracts contain pinned deployment addresses across 7 chains with AMM/chain pairs and version-tagged releases.

Audit links provided: softstackHQ/Smart-Contract-Security-Audits/Unicrypt and CertiK Skynet project page indicate audit coverage; CertiK Skynet shows 1 audit available; full audit PDFs not fetched due to GitHub access restrictions.

GitHub deployment artifacts discovered: liquidity-locker-univ2-contracts README (latest deployments June 2024, April 2024) and token-vesting-contracts README list mainnet/testnet addresses; no hardhat-deploy or foundry broadcast artifacts parsed due to repository navigation limits.

Multi-chain enumeration complete across pinned chains: Ethereum, Binance, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, xDai. V2 lockers deployed to: ETH, Arbitrum, Optimism (not pinned), Polygon, Base, BSC, Avalanche. V3 lockers: Polygon, Avalanche, Optimism, Unichain (not pinned). Token Vesting: ETH, BSC, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Optimism, Gnosis (not pinned).
Locker contracts identified as factory-pattern infrastructure that hold user LP tokens and manage lock state; user-created locks are not enumerable via contract view methods in this discovery phase.

Role taxonomy applied: 'locker' for LP locking contracts (v1, v2, v3), 'vesting' for token vesting contracts, 'token' for UNCX token, 'other' for legacy/v1 variants and alternative AMM-specific lockers.
All 37 recorded addresses in admin_addresses[] are traceable to fetched GitHub repository README files (liquidity-locker-univ2-contracts, liquidity-locker-univ3-contracts, token-vesting-contracts).

rationale.verdict: Comprehensive discovery across official GitHub repositories yielded 37 core protocol addresses spanning LP lockers (V1, V2, V3), token vesting contracts, and the UNCX governance token, distributed across 7 blockchain networks (Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Optimism, and Gnosis). All addresses sourced from pinned release READMEs with deployment metadata (chain, AMM, version). Audit coverage confirmed via CertiK Skynet and SoftStack GitHub links but full reports not fetched. No testnet-only contracts included in admin_addresses; legacy v1 lockers retained for completeness.

protocol_metadata.about: UNCX Network (formerly UniCrypt) is a DeFi infrastructure protocol launched in June 2020 providing liquidity locking and token vesting services. It enables projects to lock LP tokens on Uniswap V2/V3 across multiple chains to prevent rug pulls, and to implement time-locked vesting schedules for ERC20 tokens. The protocol operates via immutable locker contracts where users lock liquidity provider tokens or individual ERC20 tokens until a specified unlock date, with on-chain transparency for investor verification.
